baseline.method: Independent original sdt-python Crocker-Grier on all10native pMHC frames

matching_definition: Within each identical frame, maximize matches within0.5pixel then minimize Euclidean distance; no alignment/rescaling. F1=2matched/(Nestimate+Nreference).
rmse_definitions: All losses divided by total reference count. Matched squared errors: Euclidean position in pixels; relative mass (estimate/reference-1); size difference in pixels; eccentricity difference. Each unmatched reference contributes1 to every squared loss. Extra detections lower F1.
tolerance_provenance: Nonzero float64 arithmetic envelope fixed before extraction; see test/validation.md
